title: Ankhorage Deploy
summary: Provides declarative deployment orchestration for Expo applications across web, iOS, and Android.
purpose: Centralize application release planning and execution while delegating provider-specific behavior to explicit adapters.
responsibilities: Provide deployment, authoring, project, CLI, and capability entrypoints.
Plan and execute web, iOS, and Android application releases.
Delegate provider-specific shipment to declared deployment-provider packages.
boundaries: Does not implement provider-specific deployment protocols in its core.
Does not own application source code or provider credentials.
audience: Application teams and tooling that author and execute deployment releases.
useCases: Plan and execute an Expo application release.
Integrate deployment capability through the package CLI and authoring entrypoints.

architecture.role: A deployment orchestration library with explicit provider integrations.
invariants: Provider-specific behavior is delegated through declared dependencies.
Deployment intent remains explicit and portable.

limitations: Provider availability and credentials remain external configuration.
